name: Jest of the Traitor’s Prison
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 5

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target: one enemy

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target makes a melee attack against a creature of your choice that is in melee range of the target as an immediate action.
